selection_reason: Two different backbone families and three established local judge families; focused feasibility study, not a new best-combination selection.

knn.reference_pool: Frozen training split; exclude target group
knn.threshold_grid: 0..101 percent; select configuration with validation weighted F1, tie higher cutoff then deterministic method name
knn.sample: All existing 500 validation and 500 test selected cases per cell; inverse inclusion weights required
knn.evaluation: Design-weighted direct-classifier metrics, compare saved linear probe on same cases; no test tuning

retrieval.targets: Hash-selected 100 validation and100 test per backbone/dataset from parent selected500; outcome-independent selection; inherited design weight / .2
retrieval.encoder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 exact revision frozen before use; token-mean chunks cover entire serialized conversation, no full-text truncation
retrieval.prompt: Same neutral retrieved-reference wording and numeric label descriptions for BOTH new retrieval arms, exact original task and probability instruction. Retain neighbour text, label, frozen probe prediction. Original NN/control results may be reused only as separately labelled prior-prompt comparisons.

confirmation.targets: Up to100 unused val and100 unused test per backbone/dataset, exclude groups in available prior selected_flags manifests across experiments; record inventory and exclusions. No assertion of a fresh dataset/distribution.
confirmation.weights: Eligible remaining population / selected count per split/cell
confirmation.shortage: Keep all available without replacement; report missing/short cells, never substitute previously used cases

controlled.provenance: Assistant-authored explicit-rule diagnostic minimal pairs, not benchmark gold, not independently human-validated; no invented probe scores
controlled.scope: Endorsement versus condemnation and possibility versus certainty; lexical variants share a template and are not independent mechanism replications
controlled.role: Initial collection and plumbing pilot before a larger independently checked intervention study

analysis.primary: Fixed50 probe and judge; direct classifier comparisons separately
analysis.secondary: Validation-only joint cutoffs, share cutoff pair across explanation arms under each anchor; average paired deltas across anchors; compare precision-recall, input tokens and measured latency
analysis.uncertainty: Paired target/group-cluster uncertainty; synthetic template families not independent trials
analysis.causal_limits: Retrieval treatment causal within target, interpretation of why it helps requires independent source checks; expressed rationales not internal reasoning

integrity: Separate root, never alter old outputs, no automatic retry of attempted/ambiguous batches, raw saved before parse, all invalid outcomes retained, finite/input/hash checks,20GiB reserve, no numerical agreement gates
human_review: Pending independent human readers; prepare a blinded packet, do not claim assistant-authored labels are human labels
launch: One controller for controlled then encoder preparation then natural calls; separate CPU kNN process. First two batches per judge are smoke checked and retained.
